Archived array regrading, not a rerender

Re-aggregate ALL original900 full-array and8x144 endpoint stored inferences with current metrics. No rerender, solver change, new test or claim of improved-engine hardware validation. Existing outcomes are already known; only the new complete coverage-aware analysis is preregistered. Preserve exact archives/producer hashes. Map legacy held-out metadata to seen validation in derived summaries only. Primary useful-fix rate; secondary risk-coverage area (both over all scenes). Include every array, suppress comparisons on missing/unequal populations, preserve nulls and ties. Shared bootstrap500 whole scene/seed runs; within-site seeds remain correlated, not independent field sites. Point-leader flips are descriptive, not significant superiority or hardware winners.

Mixed-range target colours are indicative only; provisional error targets apply within50m. No hardware winner.
